rules.M001: Exports require unique manifests and preview fixtures
rules.M002: Source and preview paths stay inside the repository
rules.M004: Shared components cannot depend on hosted services
rules.M005: Component implementations use semantic colour tokens; only src/tokens.css defines colours
rules.M006: Every component has an executable test profile, supported probe and closed-vocabulary capabilities
rules.M007: Source and preview import-closure fingerprints must match; generated fields stay out of manifests
rules.M009: Accent tokens are declared for every brand and appearance
rules.M010: Manifest dependencies match the catalogue components the source renders
